newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel share funds post 15.3 pct return in January.
newsitem.headline: Israel share funds post 15.3 pct return in January.

text.p: Israeli mutual share funds averaged a 15.3 percent return in January, outperforming a strong Tel Aviv share market, Meitav Securities and Investments said in its monthly survey released on Monday.

A quieter bond market cut the return for all mutual funds, but Meitav's mutual funds index rose 7.1 percent for January, the biggest monthly rise since July 1994, said Meitav. Meitav, a brokerage house and fund manager that tracks the industry, surveys all 310 Israeli mutual funds.
The Tel Aviv Stock Exchange's Mishtanim index of top 100 stocks rose 14.8 percent in January, marking the third month of a stock market rally.
Meitav said the increase in trading volume to a daily average of 140 million shekels from 80 million shekels in December indicated that the market was climbing out from its three-year slump.
"Another notable sign of the awakening was the sharp increase in orders by customers at bank branches to buy stocks in general and mmutual fund units in particular," Meitav said.
Muutal funds specialising in bonds registered a 4.2 percent average return, following a two percent rise in the general bond index in January.
